test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 29 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following leaders had gone to Lucknow to invite Mahatma Gandhi to see the plight of the peasants in Champaran?
solution:
The correct answer is** __Raj Kumar Shukla__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Raj Kumar Shukla was** born** in **Satwariya Village**, and was a **resident of Murli Bharahwa** in Bihar.
 
• The** 31st Session of INC, 1916,** At the Lucknow held under the **presidency of A.C. Mazumdar.**
 
• In this Session Shukla met Gandhiji and made Gandhiji aware of the actual situation of the cultivators in Champaran and invited him to visit Champaran.
 
• **Brajkishor Prasad** made intricate plan for the Champaran Movement.
 
• **Peer Mohamed Munis** wrote the **request letter **to Gandhiji for visiting Chamaparan ,and it was handed to Gandhiji by Shukla.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hasrat Mohani **coined **"Inquilab Zindabad" ("Long Live the Revolution"),** a rallying cry for Indian freedom fighters against British rule.
 
• Hasrat Mohani founded **"Urdu-e-Moalla," an influential journal** promoting Urdu literature and supporting India's independence movement against British rule.
 
• **J. B. Kripalani chaired** the Indian National Congress session in** Meerut in 1946,** crucial during the final phase of India's independence.
 
• **Dr. Rajendra Prasad chaired** the Indian National Congress sessions in **1934 in Bombay and 1939 in Tripuri**, significant for India's independence.
 
• Dr. Rajendra Prasad was the** first President of India, serving from 1950 to 1962.**
